content.summary: Reviewed and corrected commit-phase work items using explorer + upstream PR context

data.decision: Refined committed work items to enforce project-scoped git source, directory-grouped sidebar, stage-aware diff selection, and append-to-prompt submission semantics
data.rationale: The initial commit packet had useful structure but missed key constraints from exploration and user intent (tree view in scope, no auto-send on submit, and stage-aware diffs). Updated criteria now align with feasibility findings and pragmatic scope boundaries.
